practice.title: Practice
practice.help: Choose one question, or practice every question in a part. You can try again as many times as you want.

read_aloud.title: Read a text aloud
read_aloud.directions: A short text will appear. Use the preparation time to read it silently, including names, numbers, and any list. When the tone sounds, read the text aloud in a clear voice. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.
read_aloud.directionsOne: A short text will appear. Use the preparation time to read it silently, including names, numbers, and any list. When the tone sounds, read the text aloud in a clear voice. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.

describe_picture.title: Describe a picture
describe_picture.directions: A picture will appear. Use the preparation time to notice the place, the people, and what they are doing. When the tone sounds, describe the picture in detail. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.
describe_picture.directionsOne: A picture will appear. Use the preparation time to notice the place, the people, and what they are doing. When the tone sounds, describe the picture in detail. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.

respond_questions.title: Respond to questions
respond_questions.directions: You will answer three questions about one everyday situation. The situation stays on the screen. Each question gives you a few seconds to prepare, then time to speak. Answer the first questions directly. On the last one, give reasons. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.
respond_questions.directionsOne: You will answer one question about an everyday situation. The situation stays on the screen. You get a few seconds to prepare, then time to speak. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.

info_questions.title: Answer using a document
info_questions.directions: You will have time to study a document quietly. Then you will answer three questions about it. The document stays on the screen while you answer. If a question includes a detail that does not match the document, correct it. On the last question, mention at least two items from the document. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.
info_questions.directionsOne: You will have time to study a document quietly. Then you will answer one question about it. The document stays on the screen. If the question includes a detail that does not match the document, correct it. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.

opinion.title: Express an opinion
opinion.directions: You will read one question about work, study, or daily life. Use the preparation time to choose a side and think of reasons and examples. When the tone sounds, explain your opinion clearly. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.
opinion.directionsOne: You will read one question about work, study, or daily life. Use the preparation time to choose a side and think of reasons and examples. When the tone sounds, explain your opinion clearly. Recording starts and stops by itself. You cannot pause.
